title: Status Pills in All Chats (taste prototype, opt-in agentPane.display.chatListStatusPills): a live agent's All Chats row (History page) ends with a Running, then Needs you, then Done pill

fake.description: A stand-in release agent: one turn runs the checks, asks to deploy once /tmp/cmux-agent-badges/go exists, and wraps up once the ask is answered; it logs to /tmp/cmux-agent-badges/agent.log (Agent badges tour)

steps.title: An agent chat first, so the agent daemon (acpmux) is up before the live agent starts
The agent's folder; the files there drive its turn
A live agent starts in Release and runs the release checks
cmux: Run the release checks, then deploy to staging.

steps.title: A terminal tab in front of the agent in Release
New workspace Board, for the History (All Chats) page
History (All Chats) with the setting off (today's row: a plain state word)
Turn on Status Pills in All Chats
Running: the live chat's row ends with a Running pill
The checks pass; the agent asks to deploy
Needs you: the pill turns to Needs you in place
The person answers the ask; the agent wraps up
cmux: cd /tmp/cmux-agent-badges; cmux agents dialog list > dialogs.json 2>&1; cmux agents dialog answer "$(python3 -I request_id.py < dialogs.json)" --mode deny > answer.txt 2>&1

steps.title: Done: the pill turns to Done
